findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: claimondo_finde_sachverstaendige, claimondo_melde_schaden · Private data: claimondo_fall_status, claimondo_termin_absagen · Public sink: claimondo_melde_schaden.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: claimondo_finde_sachverstaendige, claimondo_melde_schaden · Private data: claimondo_fall_status, claimondo_termin_absagen · Public sink: claimondo_melde_schaden

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "claimondo_finde_gutachter_termine" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
